title: To celebrate the release of Tetramental.com Multiplayer is free for the weekend!
author: playtetramental
selftext:
Hi everyone! I’ve been developing [Tetramental](https://tetramental.com/go/rd-play-1) for just about a year (nights and weekends), and I’m excited to share it. It’s a tile-swapping game built around elements, reactions, and fusions, with elemental teachers guiding you through the challenges. Note that it's ready to play, but still in development.

The single-player game is free to play in your browser. Multiplayer is free for everyone through Monday at 1:00 AM Eastern Time. No account needed, just pick a player name. Normally, it's only open as a gift to those who support development.

Try the Path to unlock Powers and Reactions first!

Since this is r/aigamedev, here’s how I’ve used AI:

* **Code:** Written with Claude Code. The browser game you’ll play is TypeScript; the full game is in development in Godot. I handle the game design, testing, balancing, and tuning, with a lot of playing and reworking along the way.
* **Art:** ChatGPT for artwork, plus Adobe Photoshop and Firefly for creating and editing the game’s tiles.
* **Audio:** ElevenLabs for sound effects (each picked from a set after listening) and Ableton Live and Suno Studio for the music.

This started with a small TypeScript puzzle game I made while learning, then grew into something much more ambitious. Seeing the elemental mechanics come together and getting to share something people can actually play has been really exciting.

You can play at [https://tetramental.com](https://tetramental.com/go/rd-play-1), and I’ve written up the whole process, including what it cost, at [https://tetramental.com/how-its-made/](https://tetramental.com/go/rd-how-1).

Send a match to a friend for a live duel, or practice against a computer student if you’re on your own. I’d love to hear what you think, and I’m happy to answer questions about how it was made.
